paragraphs: Rav Acha bar Yosef came before Mar Ukva, etc. Next day he asked in the study hall; they told him, “Rav Adda recited”—some say Mar bar Rav Adda—etc. Rabbi Chiyya bar Avin told him, “I asked your teacher” (our version lacks “your teacher”), “Rav Adda bar Ahavah, and Rav Huna,” etc. He was very old, leaning on his sister’s son Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak’s shoulder. (Rif and Asheri read Rabbi Chiyya bar Yosef leaning on Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak’s shoulder.) He told him, “When we reach Rav Safra’s house” (our version has Chisda), “bring me in,” Shabbat 140a. He was Rav Huna’s student. It appears he is not Rav Acha bar Rav Yosef: this one was in Mar Ukva and Shmuel’s time, while the son of Rav Yosef, Shmuel’s student—the source marks an error here.
